compatibility.api: Adds the anonymous A2A adapter; existing catalog GET operations and schemas stay compatible.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 and its four existing tools keep their current contracts.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.2.0 and both exact aliases remain compatible and immutable. A2A is an independent transport; no SDK method changes. Source coordination metadata tracks this release while existing npm/tag bytes remain those published for catalog parity.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.2.0 adds read-only A2A selection with anonymous MCP/HTTP fallbacks; MIT-0 remains unchanged.
compatibility.a2a: First application release, using the A2A 1.0 stateless JSON-RPC direct-Message profile.
